This has the potential to exaggerate the significance of net flows in institutional index products on blackrock 's revenues and earnings. # BLK Fiscal 2012 Figures

## Asset Allocation and Multi-Asset Class AUM

### Asset Allocation
- **12/31/2012**: $140,160 million (Source: [BLK fiscal 2012 annual report (10-K), page 31](documents/report.md))

### Multi-Asset Class AUM
- **12/31/2012**: $267,748 million (Source: [BLK fiscal 2012 annual report (10-K), page 31](documents/report.md))
- **Net New Business**: $15,817 million (Source: [BLK fiscal 2012 annual report (10-K), page 31](documents/report.md))
- **12/31/2011**: $225,170 million (Source: [BLK fiscal 2012 annual report (10-K), page 31](documents/report.md))

## Portion of Total Multi-Assets Related to Asset Allocation
- **Portion**: 
  - Asset Allocation (12/31/2012): $140,160 million
  - Total Multi-Asset (12/31/2012): $267,748 million
  - **Calculation**: 140,160 / 267,748 = 0.5234 or 52.34%

### Conclusion
As of December 31, 2012, approximately 52.34% of the total multi-asset class AUM is related to asset allocation. (Source: [BLK fiscal 2012 annual report (10-K), page 31](documents/report.md))

# BLK Fiscal 2012 Figures

## Asset Allocation and Multi-Asset Class AUM

### Multi-Asset Class AUM
- **12/31/2012**: $267,748 million (Source: [BLK fiscal 2012 annual report (10-K), page 31](documents/report.md))
- **Net New Business**: $15,817 million (Source: [BLK fiscal 2012 annual report (10-K), page 31](documents/report.md))
- **12/31/2011**: $225,170 million (Source: [BLK fiscal 2012 annual report (10-K), page 31](documents/report.md))

## Portion of Total Multi-Assets Related to Asset Allocation
- **Portion**: 
  - Asset Allocation (12/31/2012): $140,160 million
  - Total Multi-Asset (12/31/2012): $267,748 million
  - **Calculation**: 140,160 / 267,748 = 0.5234 or 52.34%

### Conclusion
As of December 31, 2012, approximately 52.34% of the total multi-asset class AUM is related to asset allocation. (Source: [BLK fiscal 2012 annual report (10-K), page 31](documents/report.md))
